page.content:
Campaign 1 party: Vex, Vax, Percy, Pike, Keyleth, Grog, Scanlan.

How Vox Machina connects

  • Work: Campaign 1 — Vox Machina is the player party of Campaign 1.
  • Character: Vex'ahlia — Vex'ahlia is the ranger of Vox Machina.
  • Character: Percival de Rolo — Percy is the gunslinger of Vox Machina.
  • Character: Vax'ildan — Vax'ildan is the rogue of Vox Machina.
  • Character: Pike Trickfoot — Pike Trickfoot is the cleric of Vox Machina.
  • Character: Keyleth — Keyleth is the druid of Vox Machina.
  • Character: Grog Strongjaw — Grog Strongjaw is the barbarian of Vox Machina.
  • Character: Scanlan Shorthalt — Scanlan Shorthalt is the bard of Vox Machina.
  • Series: The Legend of Vox Machina — Vox Machina is the adventuring party of the animated series.
  • Location: Whitestone — Vox Machina retakes and later calls Whitestone home.

What is Vox Machina?

Vox Machina is the adventuring party of Campaign 1 — twins Vex and Vax, Percival de Rolo, Pike Trickfoot, Keyleth, Grog, and Scanlan — who save Whitestone and later face Vecna.

Key threads lead to Campaign 1, Vex'ahlia, Percival de Rolo, Vax'ildan, Pike Trickfoot and Keyleth.
